title: I built an AI trading app. I gave it a BTC chart, and it told me to WAIT 👀
author: xMavchartAI
selftext:
What if you could turn a simple trading chart screenshot into a complete AI analysis?  
That’s exactly what I built with xMav Chart AI. 🚀  
In this video, I tested the app with a BTCUSD chart.  
Instead of forcing a BUY or SELL signal, the AI suggested WAIT.  
The app analyzes market trends, evaluates setups, and provides potential Entry, Stop Loss and Take Profit levels when appropriate.  
No guaranteed profits. Just an AI-powered second opinion for your trading decisions.  
📱 Available on iOS and web.  
🚀 Try it free with your own chart:  
https://xmavchartai.com
